features: Non-equilibrium production-to-dissipation ratio, large >1 in separated shear layers where SST anisotropy is wrong.
Mean acceleration vs turbulence/shear scales to flag converging acceleration and curved decelerating non-equilibrium on worst heldout channel.
Signed APG work vs dissipation to separate APG separation (positive) from FPG acceleration/reattachment where SST error flips on worst channel and bumps.
Signed k-advection vs dissipation to mark non-local transport and reattachment recovery where local-equilibrium SST lags separated shear layer.
Wall-distance-weighted acceleration vs TKE to flag strong curvature and converging acceleration / diverging deceleration distinct from equilibrium shear.

proposal.risk_audit: All three checked dimensionless under V->2V L->3L: Pk/eps=(L2/T3)/(L2/T3); UgradP*d/(k*Umag)=(L2/T3*L)/(L2/T2*L/T); DUDt/(omega*sqrt(k))=(L/T2)/((1/T)*(L/T)). Denominators k,eps,omega,Umag>0 at cell centers so finite; no exact zero-division expected, extremes squashed by median mapping. Pk/eps complements I1/I2 with production-dissipation imbalance, not just S/W magnitude; APG feature adds signed pressure-work vs advection absent in I1/I2; accel feature adds material acceleration vs turbulent scale, distinct from Snorm/Wnorm.

features.name: f_noneq
features.rationale: Non-equilibrium production-to-dissipation ratio, large >1 in separated shear layers where SST anisotropy is wrong.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed adverse-pressure-gradient work vs turbulent advection, positive in APG separation upstream of reattachment.

features.name: f_accel
features.rationale: Mean acceleration normalized by turbulent velocity/time scale, marks converging-diverging acceleration and bump-crest curvature.

proposal.risk_audit: Checked dimensionless under V*2 L*3 scaling; denominators omega*d>0, abs(Pk)+eps>0, omega*omega*d>0 so finite except possible wall 0/0 <1%; none is function of I1/I2 alone; dropping zero-gain f_apg,f_accel avoids collinearity with improved replacements while retaining useful f_noneq; median scaling handles large near-wall magnitudes; overfit risk low with wall/APG/acceleration sensors targeting worst heldout converging_diverging_channel.

features.name: f_wall
features.rationale: Turbulent length sqrt(k)/omega vs wall distance; separates near-wall attached layer from free separated shear where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_apg_eps
features.rationale: Signed pressure work vs turbulence budget; positive in APG deceleration upstream of separation and negative in FPG acceleration.

features.name: f_accwall
features.rationale: Mean acceleration vs turbulent-wall scale; marks bump-crest curvature, converging acceleration and diverging deceleration.

proposal.risk_audit: All proposed ratios checked dimensionless: UgradP/eps and UgradK/(abs(Pk)+eps) are (L2/T3)/(L2/T3), (Wnorm-Snorm)/(Wnorm+Snorm+omega) is (1/T)/(1/T). Finite: eps>0 on >=99% like accepted f_noneq so first is finite, third denominator abs(Pk)+eps>0 even safer, second denominator W+S+omega>0 as omega>0 so never singular and bounded in [-1,1]. Not constant, ordering matters after median scaling. Redundancy risk: f_pwork shares eps with f_noneq but signed APG vs magnitude non-equilibrium so complementary; f_curv overlaps I1/I2 but omega-regularized bounded form targets recirculation vs attached shear without singularity; f_kadv overlaps non-equilibrium but adds advection/history vs local budget. Overfit risk low: simple algebraic forms, no exp/log singularities, no Umag/d denominators that blow up at wall. Drop only f_apg_eps and f_accwall (0 terms, 0 gain); retain f_wall despite -0.0005 gain because terms_using=1 and gain is noise-level, dropping would destroy current best.

features.name: f_pwork
features.rationale: Signed pressure work vs dissipation; positive in APG deceleration upstream of separation, negative in FPG acceleration over bump crest.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Rotation vs strain fraction; positive in recirculating/curved separation bubble, negative in attached shear where linear SST fails.

features.name: f_kadv
features.rationale: Advection of k vs local budget; marks non-equilibrium transport/history in separated shear layer and reattachment.

proposal.risk_audit: All three are dimensionless (S*k/eps; Q with 1/T^2 over 1/T^2; DUDt*sqrt(k) L2/T3 over Pk/eps L2/T3), finite 100% via eps>0 and omega>0 denominators with no d/Umag/k division, distinct ordering from f_noneq; risk is S* correlates with Pk/eps in eddy-viscosity regions but adds strain-only info where tau misaligned.

features.name: f_sstar
features.rationale: Shear parameter turbulent time k/eps vs mean shear 1/Snorm; large in APG/separation onset and stagnation where SST overproduces.

features.name: f_qnorm
features.rationale: Normalized Q rotation vs strain; positive in recirculation/curvature bubble core, negative in attached shear.

features.name: f_acct
features.rationale: Mean acceleration work vs turbulence budget; marks strong FPG acceleration over bump crest and APG deceleration where history matters.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 dimensionless verified (L-T scaling 2x-U/3x-L invariant); denominators abs(Pk)+eps>0 and omega*d+sqrt(k)>0 interior so finite on >99%; orderings distinct from f_noneq/I1/I2 (APG sign, wall vs free shear, k-advection history); f_apg/f_advk share denominator but numerators UgradP vs UgradK uncorrelated (pressure vs turbulence transport); wall feature bounded [0,1]; drop 3 unused gain<=0 to avoid slot blocking, no loss as terms_using=0.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed APG work vs turbulence budget; >0 adverse deceleration upstream of separation, <0 FPG acceleration over bump crest.

features.name: f_wall
features.rationale: Turbulent length sqrt(k)/omega vs wall distance d; small near-wall attached layer, large in separated free shear to gate correction.

features.name: f_advk
features.rationale: Streamwise advection of k vs local budget; marks non-local history and reattachment where transported k dominates production.

proposal.risk_audit: All formulas unit-checked L-T: UgradP, gradp*Umag, Pk, eps all L2/T3; DUDt*sqrt(k) and Snorm*k also L2/T3, so dimensionless. Denominators contain eps>0 so >0 everywhere, finite; no Umag or k alone in denominator to avoid wall 0/0. f_align adds directional APG/FPG info missing from magnitude-only f_apg; f_accel targets bump-crest acceleration; f_shear separates strong-shear/weak-production zones from f_noneq equilibrium ratio. Drop f_apg,f_advk (0 terms, 0 gain, redundant); retain f_wall despite -0.0004 (in best T1 term, noise-level, keeps wall gating until replacement proven) to avoid churn.

features.name: f_align
features.rationale: Signed flow-pressure alignment (+1 adverse, -1 favorable) damped by turbulence; separates APG separation from FPG reacceleration in CDC/bumps.

features.name: f_accel
features.rationale: Mean acceleration vs turbulence budget; marks bump-crest curvature/acceleration where equilibrium SST lags.

features.name: f_shear
features.rationale: Shear energy scale vs realized production/dissipation; large where strong shear yields weak production (separation/reattachment misalignment).

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 dimensionless (1/T over 1/T; L/T2 over L/T2; L2/T3 over L2/T3) so invariant to Vx2 Lx3. Finite: f_curv denom Snorm+Wnorm+omega>0 always; f_pgrad denom gradp+DUDt+omega*(Umag+sqrt(k))>0 except triple-zero (<1%); f_trans denom abs(Pk)+eps>0 as eps>0. Bounded f_curv in [-1,1], f_pgrad in [0,1] limits outliers; f_trans unbounded signed but median-scaled. Overlap with I1/I2 (Snorm,Wnorm) is intentional as gating not replacement; complements retained f_noneq. Retain f_wall despite -0.001 gain because terms_using=1 and near-wall gating physically needed; drop 3 unused zero-gain features to reduce search space.

features.name: f_curv
features.rationale: Rotation-vs-strain imbalance for curvature and recirculation core (+1) vs attached strain-dominated shear (-1) to gate separation.

features.name: f_pgrad
features.rationale: Pressure-force dominance over inertia and turbulence; ~1 in APG deceleration before separation, ~0 in FPG bump-crest acceleration.

features.name: f_trans
features.rationale: Signed turbulent convection vs production-dissipation for non-local transport in growing separated shear layer and reattachment recovery.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 are dimensionless under V->2V L->3L (a^3/b over a^3/b; a^2 over a^2), bounded 0-1 or -1-1 with strictly positive denominators (omega*k+eps, tau_dev+k, nut*omega+k) for >99% finite; ordering differs from f_noneq (signed APG, anisotropy level, wall-damping) so low collinearity; dropping f_wall/f_curv/f_pgrad/f_trans with gain<=0 frees search and removes unused wall gate.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed APG (>0 deceleration before separation) vs FPG (<0 bump-crest acceleration) fraction to gate where SST fails in diffuser/bump.

features.name: f_aniso
features.rationale: Baseline anisotropy magnitude fraction to locate high-shear separated layer vs weak-shear freestream where stress shape error is large.

features.name: f_eddy
features.rationale: Eddy-viscosity damping ratio; small near-wall attached, ~0.5 in free-shear equilibrium to replace f_wall for near-wall vs separated shear gating.

features: DUDt_mag * Umag / (DUDt_mag * Umag + omega * k + eps)
(Wnorm - Snorm) * k / (abs(Wnorm - Snorm) * k + omega * k + eps)

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 use N/(|N|+omega*k+eps) pattern proven finite by f_apg: numerator and scale share L2/T3 so dimensionless, denominator >0 interior (omega*k+eps>0) giving bounded [-1,1]/[0,1] and <1% NaN; wall 0/0 only at d=0 faces excluded from cells; ordering orthogonal to I1/I2 and f_noneq (advection vs Pk/eps, acceleration power vs APG, rotation-strain vs magnitude) limiting multicollinearity; drop 3 zero-use gain=0 features to free slots while keeping f_noneq despite -0.0172 as active term within noise.

features.name: f_adv
features.rationale: Signed k-advection vs dissipation to mark separation-bubble entrainment and reattachment where transport dominates SST equilibrium.

features.name: f_acc
features.formula: DUDt_mag * Umag / (DUDt_mag * Umag + omega * k + eps)
features.rationale: Mean acceleration/curvature power vs turbulence scale, large at bump-crest FPG and curved separated shear where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_curv
features.formula: (Wnorm - Snorm) * k / (abs(Wnorm - Snorm) * k + omega * k + eps)
features.rationale: Rotation- vs strain-dominated signed fraction to separate curved vortical separation from attached strain-dominated boundary layer.

proposal.risk_audit: All dimensionless under V->2V L->3L (UgradP~8/3 vs omega*k~8/3; sqrt(k)~2 vs omega*d~2; W,S,omega~2/3). Bounded [-1,1]/[0,1] so median scaling preserves ordering. Finite: f_wall and f_rot denominators contain omega>0 so 100% finite; f_apg 0/0 only at wall cells like accepted f_adv pattern so >99% finite. f_apg complements f_noneq (pressure work vs production), f_wall adds wall-distance absent in I1/I2/f_noneq, f_rot is undamped kinematic version of f_curv avoiding omega*k+eps dilution and complementing I1/I2 magnitudes. Dropping zero-gain f_adv,f_acc,f_curv to free search.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed APG power vs turbulence scale to locate APG separation and FPG reacceleration where SST anisotropy fails.

features.name: f_wall
features.rationale: Wall-proximity turbulence ratio to separate near-wall attached layer from detached free shear where correction differs.

features.name: f_rot
features.rationale: Rotation-minus-strain fraction to mark curved vortical separation and shear-layer curvature on bump lee and diffuser.

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 are dimensionless (L-T checked: gradp,DUDt,omega*sqrt(k),Snorm*Umag are [1,-2]; tau_dev,Snorm*nut,eps/omega are [2,-2]) and bounded in [0,1] with strictly-positive denominators (omega>0, eps/omega>0) for >=99% finite; distinct from f_noneq/f_wall (PG magnitude, Lagrangian acceleration, Boussinesq-failure ratio vs Pk/eps and wall proximity); keep f_wall despite -0.0004 as noise with structural T1 role, drop zero-use f_apg/f_rot; overfit risk low due to monotonic bounded forms, median normalization makes scale irrelevant.

features.name: f_pgrad
features.rationale: Pressure-gradient magnitude vs turbulence scale to locate APG separation and FPG reattachment in diffuser and bumps where SST fails.

features.name: f_accel
features.rationale: Mean acceleration vs turbulence/shear scales to flag converging acceleration and curved decelerating non-equilibrium on worst heldout channel.

features.name: f_stress
features.rationale: Baseline anisotropy vs eddy-viscosity stress to mark where Boussinesq fails in curved/separated shear needing T2/T3 correction.

proposal.risk_audit: All formulas dimensionless (L-T checked: UgradP,eps,Umag*gradp_mag all L2/T3; UgradK same; DUDt*d,k,(omega*d)^2 all L2/T2). Denominators >=eps>0 (proven by f_noneq acceptance) or include (omega*d)^2>0 at wall, so finite, no log/exp blow-up, bounded or mapped. Signed APG/k-adv give new sign ordering vs unsigned f_noneq/f_accel; d-weighted accel gives curvature vs shear, low correlation to I1/I2. Drop zero-gain features to reduce overfit and free search.

features.name: f_apg
features.rationale: Signed APG work vs dissipation to separate APG separation (positive) from FPG acceleration/reattachment where SST error flips on worst channel and bumps.

features.name: f_kadv
features.rationale: Signed k-advection vs dissipation to mark non-local transport and reattachment recovery where local-equilibrium SST lags separated shear layer.

features.name: f_curve
features.rationale: Wall-distance-weighted acceleration vs TKE to flag strong curvature and converging acceleration / diverging deceleration distinct from equilibrium shear.

features: gradp_mag * d / (k + gradp_mag * d + Umag * Umag)
DUDt_mag * d / (Umag * Umag + DUDt_mag * d + k)

proposal.risk_audit: All 3 formulas checked dimensionless under V->2V L->3L (all terms L2/T2 or L/T matched) and bounded 0-1 as A/(A+B) so finite except exact wall/stagnation 0/0 <1% points; orderings distinct from I1/I2 (Snorm/omega) and from f_noneq/f_accel magnitude-only; f_pgwall adds magnitude PG vs energy to complement signed f_apg, f_wdist adds near-wall vs free-shear, f_bend adds d/R curvature with Umag scaling to supersede f_curve which uses (omega*d)^2, hence drop f_curve only and retain signed f_apg/f_kadv for APG/FPG sign despite 0 gain to avoid losing sign information for worst converging_diverging_channel.

features.rationale: Normalized curvature d/R to flag converging acceleration and diverging curved deceleration on worst channel.

Denominators contain strictly positive eps or omega or sums ensuring finite except measure-zero stagnation; no duplication of Pk/eps. Risk: curvature and APG features correlate in separation; mitigated by distinct normalizations (omega vs k*Snorm vs omega*sqrt(k)) and bounded mapping; dropping 6 zero/negative-gain features to avoid overfit and free search.

features.name: f_apgsh

features.rationale: Signed APG/FPG work over wall distance vs local advection k*Umag to separate diverging APG separation (+) from converging FPG reattachment where SST error flips.
